datasheet.measuring_angle_text: MeasuringAngle 15 degree; full angle versus half angle not specified
datasheet.target_guidance: Smooth planar target, area not less than 0.5 square meters

assumptions.angle: Interpret 15 degrees as full aperture by default; not resolved by this datasheet
assumptions.rays: 385 geometric rays: axial plus 8 rings of 48; numerical discretization, not manufacturer data
assumptions.return: Nearest sampled visible surface, even below minimum range; no reflectivity threshold
assumptions.timing: 70 ms selected to exceed recommended 60 ms; no flight delay or TTL simulation
assumptions.accuracy: 3 mm claim is not a noise standard deviation; no invented noise distribution
assumptions.acoustics: No amplitude, diffraction, attenuation, specular reflection, multipath or material model
